parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending. Allowed: id, invoice_number, invoice_date, supplier_name, supplier_id, link_type, link_reference, proration_strategy, currency_code, currency_rate, line_count, subtotal, tax_total, grand_total, allocated_amount, unallocated_amount, allocation_status, created_at, updated_at. Default: -created_at
